claims.evidence: Witness report shows only the machine wrapped in plastic; no location/service-history proof.

claims.claim: The AR-M207 is packed with extensive performance functions
claims.evidence: No functional/test photos; only brand/model markings are visible.
Witness report does not include a counter/page meter photo or any usage history.

claims.claim: New drum and toner just fitted
claims.evidence: No open/inside photos and no receipt/label showing replacement; machine is fully covered in plastic.
No power-on/print/copy test clip; plastic wrap prevents confirming jam status.

risks.risk: Not tested: may not power on, may show errors, or may fail to copy/print properly.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the machine powering on, reaching ready state, and completing one successful copy/print (showing the output).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not verified/untested (worst-case: may require service).

risks.risk: Counter/page usage unknown; could be far above the claimed threshold.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the machine’s page/counter screen (or settings page) showing total pages/usage.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case usage (treat as higher wear).

risks.risk: Drum/toner condition unknown; replacement claim may be false or may be near end-of-life.
risks.proof: A photo showing drum/toner status indicators on the panel after power-on, plus a close-up of any replacement label/serial on the drum/toner (if accessible).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming consumables may be worn and may need replacement soon.

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage or missing parts not visible under plastic wrap (dents, cracks, missing trays/covers).
risks.proof: Photos taken after removing plastic wrap: front, rear, both sides, and all trays/covers laid out; include a checklist photo of included accessories (power cable, trays, output tray, manuals).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming possible missing accessories/parts and potential cosmetic/structural issues.

risks.risk: Connectivity/scanning capability may not work (USB/LAN/Wi‑Fi) or may be misconfigured.
risks.proof: A clip showing LAN/USB connection and a successful scan or print from a laptop/phone (screen showing job completion).
risks.if_unproven: Price as basic/limited functionality until connectivity is proven.

risks.risk: Network/scanning setup status unknown; may require configuration or service.
risks.proof: A photo of network settings (IP address, connectivity status) and a successful scan/print over LAN.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming setup/config may be required.

proof_requests: Power-on test video: show ready state and one successful copy/print (with output).
Clear photo of the machine’s total page/counter screen.
Close-up photos of drum/toner status indicators after power-on, and any replacement labels/serials.
Remove plastic wrap and provide photos of all sides plus trays/covers; include a checklist of included accessories (power cable, trays, output tray, manuals).
Connectivity proof: show LAN/USB connection and a successful print or scan job completion.
response.reason: The witness confirms the exact model/brand (SHARP AR-M207) but the machine is fully wrapped and no functional tests, counter reading, or consumable condition are shown. Without those proof points, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
